# Model the data

After a Cursor plugin install, the short command loop is [plugins/crav1/README.md](../plugins/crav1/README.md).

The command is [`/crav1-model-data`](reference/skills/crav1-model-data.md).

## Two flows

The scope is a value, such as `orders dispatch`.

| You type | What happens |
| --- | --- |
| `/crav1-model-data manual-flow` | Discovery, then you confirm the scope, the business model, and later the physical design |
| `/crav1-model-data manual-flow orders dispatch` | The same, with that scope guiding which specs are in |
| `/crav1-model-data auto-flow` | You approve a budget, then the run continues. Unconfirmed results stay proposals |
| `/crav1-model-data` | Asks which flow. A headless run with no word stops and names the two words |

Both flows follow the same modeling rules and the same state machine, `scripts/model_run.py` in the skill. Content goes in a file (`--input` or `--text-file`). The fields are in the skill's `references/inputs.md`. `revise` records the new text, keeps the previous text, and sets that item back to proposed.

## What you should see

## Auto flow

Before each auto run you see the budget: **20 minutes** and **5 correction passes**, shared across the whole run.

A later change to a recorded decision or worked example is `revise`, and during the run that revise stays inside the current pass.

## Where it is saved

`docs/data-model/<model>/` holds the confirmed snapshots, the proposal, the questions, the two comparison views, and the review exports. An approval line names the stage and the revision, for example `Approved: business-model r2, 2026-11-08`.

The command can add `Data model: docs/data-model/<model>/` to a spec after a yes. Those edits are `/crav1-add-to-spec`, which this command does not run.

## Review

`/crav1-what-do-we-know-about-this report-data-model-full <model>` reads the saved model and writes one Markdown review and a PDF.

## After

When you asked for the review, Run next names `/crav1-what-do-we-know-about-this report-data-model-full <model>` because you asked for the review. Otherwise `Run next: nothing needed now.` When a model file changed: `Uncommitted: 1 file; commit with /crav1-finalize-commit when ready.` A requirement change is later, through `/crav1-add-to-spec`, and is not listed here.
